snippet.title: Corner Shop: NightShift – This Is What a Night Shift Looks Like (Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description:
Welcome to your first shift.

This is the official gameplay trailer for Corner Shop: NightShift – a psychological horror experience set in a small-town convenience store.

Take a look at real in-game footage from the free demo, available now on Steam.

🧾 Check customer IDs
🛒 Restock shelves
👁️ Deal with the creeping unease of the night

Things don’t just go bump in the night — they get in line to pay.

🎮 Try the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853600/Corner_Shop_Nightshift_Demo/

🛒 Wishlist the full game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306990/Corner_Shop_NightShift/
